**原神 · 千星奇域（Miliastra Wonderland）UGC 的 DSH 工具链** —— 8 个工具 + 一个侧边栏面板，把「文件层」的开发闭环做成原生工具：定位活文件、读写部署、读地图与日志、截图、探针，全程不用手动复制粘贴。这是**首个公开发布**，汇总 `0.0.4` ~ `0.0.10` 的全部内容。

<h3 id="cn-v0.0.10">新增功能</h3>

- **系统提示段重做**：从手写一段话改为由 `PROMPT_GUIDE` / `PROMPT_RULES` / `PROMPT_SKIP` 生成，并补齐此前完全缺失的指路 —— `miliastra_playtest`（0.0.4）与 `miliastra_shot`（0.0.7）**有 4 个版本没有出现在 AI 的开场提示里**，且没有任何机制会发现。现新增断言：**不在豁免表里的工具，必须有一条「什么时候用」，且工具名与说明写在同一行**。
- **主文档（README）新增「30 秒上手」**：`miliastra_health {}` 定位 → `miliastra_code op=inspect` / `op=deploy` 读写 → `miliastra_playtest` + `miliastra_log` 验证，外加三条铁律（路径不写死 / 写操作只在 code 与 probe / 不做越界的事）。
- **「工具速查」改为从代码生成**：`tools/gen-readme-tools.mjs` 从 `index.js` 的 `TOOLS` 生成 **8 875 字符**（每个工具的完整说明 + 全部参数的类型 / 必填 / 取值，即 AI 在 schema 里看到的那份），并新增 `tests/readme-test.mjs`（**10 项**）逐字比对 —— **主文档不会再落后**。

### 体验优化

- README 工具表补全此前漏掉的 op：`shot` 的 `targets`、`map` 的 `strings`、`code` 的 `backup`+`backups`、`probe` 的 `list`。
- README 新增「导航表」（按问题找工具）与「深入：几个容易搞反的点」两节，把「怎么调」与「为什么」分开。
- 系统提示段只放 schema 表达不了的**决策与纪律**，**不复述参数**：实测工具 schema **13 049 字符**，提示段 **1 166 字符（≈9%）**。
- 新增发布说明与 Release 流程（`.github/release-notes/`），按本文格式维护中英双语。

### 问题修复

- 提示段覆盖断言第一版是**假通过**：写成 `text.includes(工具名)` 时，工具名在第一行的工具清单里就有，于是「每条 bullet 根本没带工具名」也照样绿 → 改成**按行**校验「`工具名：`」，渲染同时补上工具名。
- 生成器写块用 LF 而 README 是 CRLF，导致比对报「差 **148** 字符」（147 行各多一个 `\r`）→ 改为**跟随文件自身行尾**，比对前统一 LF。
- README 里一批过时数字：工具数「6 个」→ **8 个**；测试项数 `45/28/10` → **`46/30/16`**；验证阶梯合计 `444` → **`455`**；「AI 调用三条不变量」→ **四条**。

### 版本沿革（本版之前的 0.0.4 ~ 0.0.9）

| 版本 | 加了什么 |
|---|---|
| `0.0.4` | **试玩开跑实时侦测**（`miliastra_playtest`）：读 `output_log.txt`，实测延迟 **0.07~0.18 秒** —— `.gia` 要等这一局**结束之后**才落盘，看不到「开跑那一刻」 |
| `0.0.5` | `miliastra_log op=runs` **按「局」切分 + 局间 diff**（一个 `.gia` 里可能装多局） |
| `0.0.6` | `miliastra_code op=levels`：从关卡表算**几何事实**（重叠 px / 净空 px / 真相交），**只报数字、不下判决** |
| `0.0.7` | `miliastra_shot op=burst` **连拍**：一次调用完成「等开跑 → 等 N 秒 → 连拍」；回执如实报 `measuredIntervalMs` |
| `0.0.8` | `miliastra_code op=fixbom`（只去掉那 3 字节 BOM）+ **部署指纹** + `ErrorLog.txt` 巡检 |
| `0.0.9` | `miliastra_log op=metrics` **指标汇总**（`core` = 四分位距）+ AI 调用三条不变量落地 |

### 其他变更

- 测试合计 **455 项**，`npm test` 全绿（`readme-test` 10 / `smoke` 46 / `deploy-test` 30 / `probe-deploy-test` 16 / `lualint-test` 32 / `shot-test` 103 / `playtest-test` 63 / `giaruns-test` 25 / `leveldata-test` 44 / `metrics-test` 39 / `client-render-test` 31，外加技能契约自检 16）。
- **Host 半边（工具 / 路由 / 系统提示）是启动时的快照** —— 改完必须重启 `dsh web`；只改 `lib/client.js`（面板）刷新页面即可。
- 仓库内**不写死任何绝对路径**（LocalLow 根目录由 `os.homedir()` 推导，可用 `MILIASTRA_LOCALLOW` 覆盖）。

**Full Changelog**: [首次发布，全部提交](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/commits/main)

---

**Miliastra Wonderland（Genshin Impact UGC）toolchain for DSH** — 8 tools plus a sidebar panel that turn the file-level development loop into native tools: locate the live script, deploy and verify it, read the map archive and runtime logs, take screenshots, and run probes, with no manual copy-paste. This is the **first public release**, covering everything from `0.0.4` through `0.0.10`.

<h3 id="en-v0.0.10">New Features</h3>

- **System prompt section rewritten**: generated from `PROMPT_GUIDE` / `PROMPT_RULES` / `PROMPT_SKIP` instead of hardcoded prose, closing a gap where `miliastra_playtest` (0.0.4) and `miliastra_shot` (0.0.7) **were missing from the AI's opening prompt for four releases** with no mechanism to notice. A new assertion now requires every non-exempt tool to have a "when to use" line, **with the tool name on the same line as its description**.
- **README gains a "30-second quick start"**: `miliastra_health {}` → `miliastra_code op=inspect` / `op=deploy` → `miliastra_playtest` + `miliastra_log`, plus three ground rules (never hardcode paths; only `code` and `probe` write to disk; nothing out of bounds).
- **The tool reference is now generated from code**: `tools/gen-readme-tools.mjs` renders **8,875 characters** from `TOOLS` in `index.js` (each tool's full description plus every parameter's type / required flag / allowed values — the same text the AI sees in the schema). A new `tests/readme-test.mjs` (**10 checks**) compares it byte for byte, so **the main document cannot drift again**.

### Improvements

- README tool table now lists previously missing ops: `targets` for `shot`, `strings` for `map`, `backup`+`backups` for `code`, `list` for `probe`.
- README splits "how to call it" from "why it works that way" with a problem-oriented picker table and a "gotchas" section.
- The system prompt section carries only decisions and disciplines that the schema cannot express, **never restating parameters**: tool schema is **13,049 characters**, the prompt section **1,166 characters (≈9%)**.
- Added release notes and a Release workflow under `.github/release-notes/`, maintained bilingually in this format.

### Bug Fixes

- The prompt-coverage assertion **passed falsely** at first: `text.includes(toolName)` matched the tool list on the first line, so bullets lacking a tool name still passed → changed to a per-line check for `` `tool：` ``, and the renderer now prints the tool name.
- The generator wrote LF into a CRLF README, so the comparison reported **148 characters** of difference (one `\r` on each of 147 lines) → the generator now follows the file's own line endings and normalizes to LF before comparing.
- Stale numbers in the README: "6 tools" → **8**; test counts `45/28/10` → **`46/30/16`**; verification total `444` → **`455`**; "three AI-invocation invariants" → **four**.

### Version history (0.0.4 – 0.0.9, before this release)

| Version | What it added |
|---|---|
| `0.0.4` | **Live playtest detection** (`miliastra_playtest`): reads `output_log.txt` with a measured **0.07–0.18 s** latency — `.gia` is only flushed **after** a run ends, so it cannot show the moment a run starts |
| `0.0.5` | `miliastra_log op=runs`: **split by run + diff between runs** (a single `.gia` may contain several runs) |
| `0.0.6` | `miliastra_code op=levels`: **geometry facts** from the level table (overlap px / headroom px / true intersections) — **numbers only, never a verdict** |
| `0.0.7` | `miliastra_shot op=burst`: **burst capture** in one call ("wait for start → wait N seconds → shoot N frames"), reporting the measured `measuredIntervalMs` honestly |
| `0.0.8` | `miliastra_code op=fixbom` (removes exactly those 3 BOM bytes) + **deploy fingerprint** + `ErrorLog.txt` inspection |
| `0.0.9` | `miliastra_log op=metrics` **metric summary** (`core` = interquartile range) + the three AI-invocation invariants |

### Chores

- **455 tests**, all green under `npm test` (`readme-test` 10 / `smoke` 46 / `deploy-test` 30 / `probe-deploy-test` 16 / `lualint-test` 32 / `shot-test` 103 / `playtest-test` 63 / `giaruns-test` 25 / `leveldata-test` 44 / `metrics-test` 39 / `client-render-test` 31, plus 16 skill contract self-checks).
- **The Host half (tools / routes / system prompt) is a startup snapshot** — restart `dsh web` after changing it; editing only `lib/client.js` (the panel) needs a page refresh.
- The repository **hardcodes no absolute paths** (the LocalLow root is derived from `os.homedir()` and can be overridden with `MILIASTRA_LOCALLOW`).

**Full Changelog**: [first release, all commits](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/commits/main)
